hero.title: A founder-led AI consultancy built to ship systems, not posture.
hero.summary: LeCrown Development is positioned as a modern AI consultancy, project incubator, and launch partner for teams that need execution, clarity, and a credible technical story.

visual.title: Small enough to move fast. Senior enough to stay credible.

overview: LeCrown exists to turn technical capability into deployable systems and visible proof. The company sits at the intersection of AI automation, software engineering, product incubation, and launch-oriented content.
That combination matters because many buyers do not just need code. They need a clear offer, a believable delivery path, and a system narrative that can survive technical review.

founder.name: Benjamin LaGrone
founder.title: Software Engineer, AI Developer, Technology Consultant
founder.summary: Benjamin leads LeCrown across AI systems, software delivery, and launch strategy. LinkedIn is the cleanest public snapshot of his professional background, current positioning, and network-facing contact path.

principles.title: Architecture before hype
principles.text: LeCrown leads with workflows, systems, and delivery mechanics rather than abstract AI claims.

principles.title: Execution with narrative
principles.text: The build and the story move together so buyers can understand what is real, what is next, and why it matters.

principles.title: Pilot-friendly by design
principles.text: Smaller entry points make it easier to prove value, de-risk new work, and support commercial or public-sector capture.

strengths.title: AI consultancy
strengths.text: Systems thinking, workflow redesign, and deployment-aware automation work.

strengths.title: Project incubator
strengths.text: Support for new ideas, internal ventures, pilots, and launch-ready MVPs.

strengths.title: Social proof partner
strengths.text: AI video and launch assets that help technical work look visible and credible.

strengths.title: Government-ready support
strengths.text: A structure that can speak to agencies, subcontracting paths, and proposal narratives without pretending to be a giant integrator.

cta.title: Best fit for teams that need a builder, not another layer of overhead.
cta.description: LeCrown works best when the goal is to turn an opportunity into something concrete: a system, a pilot, a product, or a sharper delivery story.
